findings.verification: The helper rejected app-owned instruction envelopes prepended when changing models, and its earlier receipts did not bind an exact model and effort. findings.visibleAuthority: Large model-switch instruction payloads became pasted-text attachments. The visible message retained only the generation marker. A completed Pro turn's token was subsequently reused in rejected discovery requests after newer tokens had been supplied. Keep the current broker token in a separate visible directive appended after paste settlement; retain the full transcript and exact draft checks.
findings.staleTokenErrors: The MCP handler used one generic failure envelope for known inactive-token rejection before admission and errors after possible invocation. Distinguish only the proven pre-admission category. Do not expose another token, remap requests, retry native actions or weaken tool annotations.
findings.proStop: Both Pro routes acknowledged one Stop click but still showed active controls at the 2400ms script bound. An isolated GPT-6 Pro repeat with its owned tab visible reproduced the failure. The same generation later showed Stopped thinking and the idle composer without a second Stop or continuation. The new shared contract allows condition-driven confirmation within a ten-second hook deadline; time alone never proves success.
